title: Alani Kelso
summary: A Division Agent who appears in Broken Dawn's Washington sequence as the recipient of April Kelleher's source-specific antiviral intelligence.

claims.text: Broken Dawn depicts Alani Kelso as a Division Agent operating in Washington during the novel's final intelligence handoff.
April Kelleher gives Kelso the novel's resulting research intelligence, including the lead's security risk and Ike Ronson's involvement.

paragraphs.text: Kelso's Broken Dawn appearance creates a source-specific bridge from April's civilian research trail to an SHD contact in Washington. The archive labels that bridge official transmedia rather than retroactively treating it as a game mission.

verification.notes: This record is limited to the licensed novel's Washington handoff; later game-story developments require separate current-canon sourcing.
